# Bundled font notices

Carrot Manga Translator bundles the original, unmodified font files listed in
[`manifest.json`](manifest.json). They are grouped in the font picker by the
script they are intended to cover; a font may contain additional scripts too.

Every bundled file remains under its upstream license. The matching license
text is stored in the directory named after the font ID. The font files may not
be sold by themselves, and modified versions must follow any Reserved Font Name
rules in their license.
